agentSummary: Adds tools for the experimental Dynamic Wind plugin in UE 5.7+: Pivot Painter tree conversion, wind skeletal data authoring, per-world wind parameters and wind-driven instanced foliage placement.
enablesAgentTo: Convert Pivot Painter 2 trees into wind-ready skeletal meshes and skeletons
Author and inspect Dynamic Wind skeletal data (simulation groups, bone chains) headlessly
Set and read back the editor or PIE world's wind direction, speed, amplitude and turbulence texture
Place instanced skinned foliage driven by a DynamicWindData transform provider
whenToEnable: Your UE 5.7+ project uses the experimental Dynamic Wind plugin for Nanite foliage.
